title: What is the life expectancy of a DeLonghi coffee machine?
desc: A DeLonghi coffee machine typically lasts between 3 to 5 years with regular use and proper care. Regular cleaning, descaling, and adherence to the maintenance instructions in the user manual can help extend its lifespan.

title: How do I contact DeLonghi customer service center?
desc: DeLonghi Coffee Machines provides technical support through a virtual expert. If further assistance is needed, you will be connected to one of our customer care specialists. To schedule a repair, call +971 4 330 0002 (Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM).

title: Do DeLonghi coffee machines need servicing?
desc: To ensure your DeLonghi coffee machines stay in excellent condition, it's recommended to have them serviced once a year. Service can be done at the service centre or at your location.

title: What happens if you don't descale DeLonghi?
desc: Without regular descaling, the water outlets can narrow, causing slow dispensing or poor water flow. This can result in coffee dripping after brewing and indicates the machine needs attention.

title: What can I use instead of DeLonghi descaler?
desc: If you're out of descaling tablets, you can use a mix of white vinegar and water as a temporary home remedy to clean your coffee maker.

title: What is the common problem of coffee machines?
desc: A common issue is slow or no water flow, often due to a misaligned water tank or internal blockages. This affects both drip and single-serve machines.

title: What happens if a coffee machine is not kept clean?
desc: Neglecting cleaning can lead to bitter coffee, unpleasant odors, and residue build-up that clogs the machine, potentially rendering it unusable.

title: What chemical is in DeLonghi descaler?
desc: DeLonghi descalers use natural lactic acid derived from plants, making them eco-friendly and safe for the environment.

title: Do coffee machines need maintenance?
desc: Yes, coffee machines should be maintained every six months. Maintenance includes descaling, cleaning brew groups and steam assemblies, and replacing anti-suction valves.

title: What happens if a coffee machine is not cleaned regularly?
desc: Unclean machines produce poor-tasting coffee and may get damaged. Filters can become blocked with coffee tannins, causing jams and breakdowns.

title: Is coffee bad for a cough with phlegm?
desc: Coffee may worsen a phlegmy cough due to its dehydrating effect, despite offering relief for some cold symptoms. Hydration is important during illness.

title: Which coffee is good for health?
desc: Overall, lighter roasts generally have less caffeine and more antioxidants than darker roasts. The type of bean can affect the caffeine content, but both Arabica and Robusta beans can give you the full health benefits of coffee.

title: What are the benefits of drinking coffee?
desc: Coffee can improve overall health, protect against Type 2 diabetes, control Parkinson’s symptoms, slow dementia, safeguard the liver, promote heart health, reduce melanoma risk, and lower mortality risk.

title: Which is better: tea or coffee?
desc: Both tea and coffee have health benefits. Tea may have a slight edge, but it depends on caffeine tolerance, personal preference, and culture.
